label: Spokane PD official data, May 1 to Sep 27, 2026 (as of Sep 27, 2026). Feed paused since Spokane's Oct 2026 records-system switch.
source: City of Spokane official ArcGIS FeatureServers (SPD_Offenses layer 18, SPD_CallsForService layer 16).
defaultWindowNote: Default is the full snapshot (May 1–Sep 27, 2026). Presets (6 months, 1 year, 5 years) are measured from the as-of date, Sep 27, 2026, not from today. A rolling 6-month window from Nov 24, 2026 would have cut off May 1–23.
locationPrecision: The official offense and calls FeatureServers include no geometry. Address values are hundred-block or an intersection, or withheld for privacy; no exact house numbers were present. CrimeStat does not display or geocode addresses. All map locations use official City of Spokane neighborhood polygons (29 neighborhoods). Incidents with no neighborhood are counted but not placed on the map. 911/CAD calls are neighborhood area counts only.
